source: 华为BLM模型管理：从战略到执行落地-Template.pptx
layout_pattern: 24 slides: opens with a cover/context slide, then a long sequential walkthrough of the BLM (Business Leadership Model) framework stage by stage, closing with a discussion prompt. One slide (21, '业务设计是SP落脚点...') was flagged 'title' by the shape-count heuristic but is actually a section-divider mid-deck, not the deck title — the classifier's shape_count<=2/char_count<40 rule misfires on short-text content slides. Same headline-as-title convention as the other two samples.

color_role_mapping.C00000: accent/emphasis red, most frequent (47) — consistent with both other samples
color_role_mapping.0070C0: secondary accent blue (36) — a blue not seen in the other two decks' top colors
color_role_mapping.002060: dark navy, likely a heading or panel color
color_role_mapping.000000: pure black, less frequent here than in the other decks

typography_hierarchy.usage: headline/takeaway sentence, matches SD-WAN deck's title size
most frequent size (55) — dominant label/body size, matches SD-WAN deck
standard body text, second most frequent (36)

data_viz_preference.note: almost entirely image-driven (20/24 slides have pictures) — diagrams and frameworks appear to be custom graphics/screenshots rather than native charts or tables, same pattern as the SD-WAN deck.

text_density_rule: 21-505 characters per slide (mean ~168), with several very short slides (21, 24, 26, 57, 60-69 characters) interspersed among dense framework-explanation slides (300-500+ characters). No fixed cap; density spikes on slides introducing a new framework component.
logic_flow: Same headline-as-conclusion title convention as the SD-WAN deck (e.g. '看行业：多年积累+随时刷新...'). Overall arc: strategic context -> BLM framework stages in sequence (战略洞察 -> 业务设计 -> 关键任务) -> closing discussion prompt on execution. A didactic, framework-teaching structure rather than a data-led argument.
image_treatment: 51 images across 24 slides (~2.1/slide), concentrated bottom-center (23) and middle-center (18) — images sit anchored to the lower/center of the slide beneath the argument text, essentially never full-bleed. 22 of 51 (43%) carry an adjacent label (e.g. brand-name lists like '星巴克 淘宝 携程 亚马逊' under a framework diagram) — used to annotate examples within a diagram, not as photo captions.
citation_style: Zero citation markers detected. Framework content (BLM stages, brand examples) is presented without attributing any external source — consistent with this being internal management-training material rather than externally-sourced research.
argument_structure: Strongly bimodal: most substantive slides carry just 2-4 content points (short framework-navigation slides), with a minority running 16-40 (dense explanation slides) — median 6, but the median understates the real structure, which alternates between terse and dense rather than clustering near the middle.
diagram_convention: 13 of 24 slides (54%) have ≥3 non-text diagram shapes forming a 2D grid, e.g. slide 19 ('创新领域...', 29 PICTURE shapes representing brand logos — 星巴克/淘宝/携程/亚马逊/迪斯尼/麦当劳/宜家 — arranged in a categorized logo wall, plus a handful of AUTO_SHAPE grouping boxes). No single-row/column sequence diagrams found. Every shape in this deck is named 'Google Shape' rather than a real PowerPoint name, confirming (via the new authoring_tool field) this file was exported from Google Slides, not authored natively in PowerPoint.
branding_footer: One inline mention of '保密' (confidential) found mid-sentence in body text (slide 15, '...依据对手现状和SP确定竞争策略（保密）') — this is a content annotation about a competitive-analysis method, not a page-level footer/classification marker. No actual footer, page-number, or confidentiality marker convention found anywhere in this sample.
data_quality_caveats: Same layout_type classifier limitation as the SD-WAN sample: it mislabels one mid-deck divider slide as 'title'. Rely on title_text and slide position, not the layout_type field, for structural claims in this deck.
